description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
Felidar Guardian's ability triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
In response, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, causing target player to mill a card.
Resolve Feldiar Guardian's trigger, blinking Karmic Guide.
Karmic Guide triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
